rspress.purpose: RSPress 2.x authority: framework source (packages/core/src) and the official site docs (website/docs/en); pinned to the installed @rspress/core version

orientation.layout: Sparse checkout of two trees. packages/core/src is the @rspress/core source: node/ (build pipeline, plugin driver, config), runtime/ and theme/ (client runtime and default theme), cli/, config/, shiki-transformers.ts. website/docs/en is the official docs site markdown: guide/, api/, plugin/ (plugin-authoring docs), ui/.

keyPaths.packages/core/src/node: build pipeline, plugin hook driver, user-config handling
keyPaths.packages/core/src/theme: default theme components (what our runtime components sit alongside)
keyPaths.website/docs/en/plugin: official plugin-authoring docs — hook semantics and plugin API
keyPaths.website/docs/en/api: config and API reference for rspress.config.ts surface

twoslash.purpose: Twoslash authority: core engine source (packages/twoslash/src) and the twoslash notation/semantics docs (docs); pinned to the installed transitive twoslash version

orientation.layout: packages/twoslash/src is the core engine: core.ts (twoslasher pipeline), validation.ts, error.ts, fallback.ts, flag-keys.ts, defaults.ts, types/. docs/ is the notation/semantics site source: guide/ holds the authoritative notation reference (queries, directives, cut markers).

keyPaths.packages/twoslash/src/core.ts: the twoslasher pipeline — how notations are parsed and applied

rsbuild.purpose: Rsbuild authority: @rsbuild/core source (packages/core/src) and the official site docs (website/docs/en) — the bundler layer under RSPress; pinned to the installed @rsbuild/core version

orientation.layout: packages/core/src is @rsbuild/core: createRsbuild.ts / createCompiler.ts (entry flow), hooks.ts and pluginManager.ts (plugin system), rspackConfig.ts + plugins/ (how user config becomes rspack config), server/ (dev server), configChain.ts / mergeConfig.ts. website/docs/en is the official docs: config/ (every rsbuild config option), api/ (JS API + plugin API), guide/, plugins/.

keyPaths.packages/core/src/rspackConfig.ts: how rsbuild config is lowered to rspack config — where builderConfig options land
keyPaths.packages/core/src/pluginManager.ts: rsbuild plugin system — hook registration and ordering
keyPaths.website/docs/en/config: authoritative reference for the builderConfig surface RSPress exposes
keyPaths.website/docs/en/api: JS API and plugin API docs

effect.purpose: Effect v4 authority: core source (packages/effect/src) and the v3-to-v4 migration notes (migration/); pinned to the installed effect version via the catalog:effect pin

orientation.layout: Sparse checkout of two trees. packages/effect/src is the effect core source: flat top-level modules (Effect.ts, Schema.ts, Context.ts, Layer.ts, FileSystem.ts, ...) plus internal/, testing/ and unstable/. In v4 the former separate packages merged into this core — @effect/platform's FileSystem is the top-level FileSystem.ts, and @effect/sql is unstable/sql. migration/ is the v3-to-v4 note set: v3-to-v4.md is the full rename ledger, with per-topic notes alongside it (schema.md, services.md, layer-memoization.md, error-handling.md, cause.md, ...). Note the sparse cut excludes test/ and typetest/ — source and notes settle existence and signature, but only a runtime probe against the installed beta settles semantics.

keyPaths.packages/effect/src/Schema.ts: the Schema surface — the module that churns most between betas (TaggedError, Error/ErrorInstance, toArbitrary, SchemaIssue)
keyPaths.packages/effect/src/Context.ts: Context.Service tags — the v4 service-declaration form
keyPaths.packages/effect/src/FileSystem.ts: FileSystem, merged into core from the former @effect/platform
keyPaths.packages/effect/src/unstable/sql: the SQL modules (SqlClient, Migrator), merged into core from the former @effect/sql

notes.note: Re-pin target: v4 pre-releases (beta and rc alike) are tagged in the MAIN Effect-TS/effect repo as `effect@<version>` (e.g. `effect@4.0.0-rc.109` -> b5946ec), NOT in Effect-TS/effect-smol — effect-smol has no 4.0.0 pre-release tags at all, despite being where the v4 rewrite originally lived. Confirm the tag exists with `git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect | grep 'effect@<version>'` before pinning. This is a monorepo, so sibling packages carry their own tags; verify a pin with `git rev-parse HEAD` inside the checkout against `git ls-files -s .repos/effect`, never `git describe --tags`.

vitepress.purpose: VitePress 2.x authority: framework source (src/node, src/client, src/shared) and the official English docs (docs/en); pinned to the VitePress version the phase-5 platforms/vitepress adapter targets

orientation.layout: src/node is the Node build side: siteConfig.ts (UserConfig, the transformPageData/transformHead/buildEnd/postRender hooks), config.ts (config resolution), markdown/ (markdown-it pipeline; plugins/highlight.ts is where Shiki and codeTransformers run), build/, plugin.ts (the Vite plugin). src/client is the Vue runtime and default theme; src/shared holds types both sides use. docs/en is the official English site markdown: guide/ and reference/ — reference/site-config.md and reference/default-theme-sidebar.md are the config surface an adapter targets.

keyPaths.src/node/siteConfig.ts: UserConfig and every site-level hook an adapter wires into
keyPaths.src/node/markdown/plugins/highlight.ts: Shiki highlighting and codeTransformers — where @shikijs/vitepress-twoslash plugs in
keyPaths.docs/en/reference/site-config.md: every config option and hook, authoritative for 2.x
sidebar config shape (navigation is config, not files)

shiki.purpose: Shiki authority: the @shikijs/twoslash transformer we consume directly (packages/twoslash), the @shikijs/vitepress-twoslash integration the phase-5 VitePress adapter leans on (packages/vitepress-twoslash) and the shiki core (packages/shiki); pinned to the installed shiki version

orientation.layout: packages/twoslash is @shikijs/twoslash — the Shiki transformer we consume directly: src/ (transformerTwoslash, renderer-rich, renderer-classic, icons), style-rich.css / style-classic.css (the hover/popup CSS our _twoslash.css mirrors), test/. packages/vitepress-twoslash is @shikijs/vitepress-twoslash — the markdown-it codeTransformer plus Vue floating-UI renderer the VitePress adapter integrates with instead of porting the remark pipeline. packages/shiki is the shiki core package (highlighter entry, bundles); its src re-exports @shikijs/core internals.

keyPaths.packages/twoslash/src: transformerTwoslash + rich renderer — the HAST our ShikiCrossLinker post-processes
keyPaths.packages/twoslash/style-rich.css: upstream popup/hover CSS that plugin runtime styling aligns with
keyPaths.packages/vitepress-twoslash/src: transformerTwoslash for VitePress: the typesCache seam, the Vue renderer, the client enhanceApp hook
keyPaths.packages/shiki/src: shiki core entry — highlighter creation, bundle composition
